security_audit.summary: All 29 static findings are false positives caused by Markdown code fences, JavaScript template literals, and a descriptive statement about direct access. The skill documents an optional broad tool-authorization setting; enabling it can violate least-privilege controls depending on the configured Copilot MCP server.

remediation.issue: The ask-copilot example exposes an allowAllTools option that may grant broad downstream tool access.
remediation.suggestion: Default to false, request explicit user confirmation before enabling it, and document which tools the server exposes.

remediation.issue: The security-review example contains an interpolated SQL query.
remediation.suggestion: Label it as intentionally vulnerable and show parameterized queries in the recommended remediation output.

semantic_findings.title: Broad Tool Authorization Option
semantic_findings.description: The ask-copilot interface documents allowAllTools=true, which can grant the downstream Copilot agent access to every available tool. This bypasses least-privilege tool selection when enabled.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The parameter is explicitly documented as allowing all available tools. The actual downstream tool set and approval controls are not documented, so impact depends on the MCP server configuration.

content.user_title: Get targeted help from Copilot MCP
content.value_statement: Development tasks can need focused review, debugging, or test support without changing workflows. This skill routes those requests to documented GitHub Copilot MCP tools with selectable models and session support.
actual_capabilities: Ask Copilot for coding help, debugging guidance, and architecture feedback.
Request focused code reviews for security, performance, maintainability, or best practices.
Explain code snippets and diagnose supplied errors with optional context.
Generate refactoring suggestions and unit test ideas from supplied code.
Suggest CLI commands for a described task.
Start sessions and retrieve their conversation history.
limitations: Requires an active GitHub Copilot subscription and configured MCP server.
Results depend on the supplied code, prompt, context, and selected model.
The skill documents tool calls but does not install or configure the MCP server.
Enabling all tools may grant the downstream agent broad access.

use_cases.title: Review a pull request change
use_cases.description: Send a focused code excerpt for a security or performance review before merging.

use_cases.title: Diagnose a runtime error
use_cases.description: Provide failing code, the error message, and context to receive debugging guidance.

use_cases.title: Prepare test coverage
use_cases.description: Ask for unit test suggestions for an existing function and name the test framework.

prompt_templates.title: Explain code
prompt_templates.prompt: Use copilot-explain to explain this code in simple steps: [paste code].

prompt_templates.title: Debug an error
prompt_templates.prompt: Use copilot-debug with this code: [paste code]. Error: [paste error]. Context: [describe what you expected].

prompt_templates.title: Review focused changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Use copilot-review on this code: [paste code]. Focus on security and maintainability. List findings by priority.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a refactor and tests
prompt_templates.prompt: Use copilot-refactor for this code: [paste code]. Goal: reduce duplication without changing behavior. Then use copilot-test-generate and target [framework].

output_examples.input: Review this login handler for security issues.
output: Finding: user input is concatenated into a database query.
Recommendation: use parameterized queries and add authentication tests.

output_examples.input: Generate Jest tests for an isPrime function.
output: Suggested cases: values below two, prime values, composite values, and large inputs.
Note: add boundary cases that match the function contract.
Cause: the response parsing method is being accessed incorrectly.
Suggested correction: await the response, then call its parsing method.

best_practices: Provide the smallest relevant code sample and describe the expected behavior.
Choose a focused review area instead of requesting every review category.
Keep allowAllTools disabled unless the required downstream access is understood and approved.
anti_patterns: Do not submit secrets, production credentials, or unnecessary personal data.
Do not use broad prompts when a specific task, error, or review focus is available.
Do not enable all tools by default for routine coding questions.

faq.question: What does this skill require?
faq.answer: It requires an active GitHub Copilot subscription and a configured Copilot MCP server.

faq.question: Can it review code for security?
faq.answer: Yes. The copilot-review tool accepts security as a focus area.

faq.question: Can it generate tests?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide code and optionally name a supported test framework.

faq.question: Can it remember related requests?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented session tools can start a session and retrieve its history.

faq.question: Does this skill configure GitHub Copilot?
faq.answer: No. It documents how to call the available MCP tools after configuration.

faq.question: Should I enable all tools?
faq.answer: Only when necessary and approved. Broad tool access can exceed least-privilege needs.
